annotations.title: Add one entry to your merge ledger

description: Record that you handed a function to an agent and at which rung, a receipt you filed, a preference, or a pointer to a file you keep. Signed by your key; LLPRO signs the entry into a chain. Not encrypted: LLPRO can read what you file. Lowering a rung is one call: shelf handover, op lower.

request.description: The owner-signed request (under 4 KB): v=1, type=ledger-write, owner_id, owner_key, at, sig, plus the fields the tool needs.
